answer: Counterparty diversity stops self-dealing rings. A new identity starts as a faint ember: low trust, capped earnings. To reach the summit of full rewards it must trade with 12 distinct counterparties across 10 epochs. An attacker minting 100 fakes needs 1,200 real partners, about 2,400 days of fees, while a ring trading only with itself scores zero and sinks to the nadir, earning nothing. An honest agent pays once and keeps its rewards undiluted.
